name: Samuel Adams Boston Brewery - Jamaica Plain, Boston MA
type: Brewery / production facility (heritage Jamaica Plain site; smaller footprint, taproom-attached)

fieldNotes.truckGate: No truck gate. This is a small heritage R&D brewery and taproom inside the historic Haffenreffer brewery complex in Jamaica Plain. Access is via narrow public residential streets; only small surface parking lots are present. No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth — small surface parking lots with painted 'PARKING' markings; visitor taproom entrance with outdoor seating. No security structure.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Extremely tight urban site embedded in Jamaica Plain residential fabric. Any delivery vehicle maneuvers on narrow public streets; a truck would block the street. Backup-sensitive by geometry, though only box trucks/vans realistically serve this site.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: No internal approach lane; delivery vehicles come straight off the street.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~2 service/loading doors at most; this is an R&D brewhouse and taproom, not a distribution facility. Band 0-10. Approximate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No trailer drop area — no trailer parking on the site at all.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: The Boston Beer footprint here is a contiguous brewery+taproom occupancy within one historic complex (shared with other tenants). Treated as a single facility -> FALSE.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail; dense urban residential neighborhood.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Jamaica Plain, within the dense urban fabric of Boston -> Urban.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: No tractor-trailers on site; this heritage R&D brewery does not run a trailer yard. Deliveries are by box truck/van.
